name: Demonic Gear Aria
original_name: デモニックギア・アリア
source: Aria's form when she uses Ark's power to transform. When she engages in a combat, she would slaughters enemies without hesitation even more than Machina. Her sadistic fighting style would make Millennium's members tremble. Her main weapon is Demonic Ninetail, a devilish tail that sprouts out countless whips.
